segment.name: Specialty
segment.systems: PAS C (DB2) · per-deal Excel raters (actuarial drive) · manuscript wording library (.docx)
segment.operatingPattern: Deal-by-deal underwritten specialty placements — every account individually priced in an Excel rater, manuscripted from the wording library, and hand-keyed into PAS C on surplus lines paper.
segment.distribution: Wholesale brokers, specialty retail brokers, select MGA relationships
segment.placement: Individually underwritten account placement on non-admitted (surplus lines) paper
segment.reinsurance: Facultative per-risk on large limits + variable quota share on the cyber book
segment.regulatory: Surplus lines — state SL premium tax and stamping filings via brokers; no admitted rate/form filings

behavior.Product Taxonomy: Product codes exist in PAS C but the real granularity lives in per-deal folders on the UW shared drive; hazard class taxonomies sit in rater tabs.
behavior.Coverages: Base grants come from carrier proprietary forms; per-account broadening and restrictions are manuscript endorsements drafted from the .docx wording library.
behavior.Terms: Claims-made structures, retro dates, SIRs and defense treatment are negotiated account by account and tracked in claims-made tracking spreadsheets.
behavior.Rating: Per-deal Excel raters on the actuarial drive; version control is by filename and the rater run is pasted into the pricing memo.
behavior.Pricing: Rater produces the technical price; the bound price is underwriter judgment documented in a Word pricing memo in the deal file.
behavior.Underwriting Rules: Referral by email to the product line leader with the deal file attached; authority grids are PDFs, nothing is systematized.
behavior.Forms: Manuscript wording library (.docx per program/account) plus carrier proprietary forms; form editions tracked manually.
behavior.Filings: Surplus lines filings log on the compliance drive tracks SL taxes, stamping fees and affidavits per state; no admitted filings exist.
behavior.Lifecycle Behavior: Submission to quote to bind is email plus Excel plus Word; bind is manually keyed into PAS C; retro dates and ERP elections live in tracking spreadsheets.

products.name: Tech E&O / MPL ProLine
products.description: Claims-made technology errors & omissions plus miscellaneous professional liability for tech services firms and professional classes, individually rated per deal and issued on surplus lines paper.

components.name: Product Taxonomy
components.expression: Deal-folder taxonomy over a thin PAS C product code

items.name: PAS C product code PL-TEO
items.description: The only system-level identity of the product — a single product master code under which every ProLine policy is keyed.
items.livesIn: PAS C (DB2) — product master table PRODMST

items.name: Tech services hazard class taxonomy
items.description: Five hazard classes (SaaS, IT consulting/integration, managed service providers, telecom, tech staffing) that drive base rates and referral rules.
items.livesIn: TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx — 'HazardClass' tab, actuarial drive

items.name: Miscellaneous PL class appendix
items.description: Appendix of 34 eligible MPL classes (consultants, recruiters, associations, media services) mapped to the same rater with class-specific factors.
items.livesIn: TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx — 'MPL-Classes' tab, actuarial drive

items.name: Version lineage v1–v5
items.description: Form-edition lineage since 2018; v4 (02/24 edition) is renewal-only, v1–v3 fully retired with mapped conversion notes.
items.livesIn: Product line SharePoint — ProLine version history page

items.name: Surplus lines eligibility map
items.description: State-by-state export-list eligibility and diligent-search requirements determining where ProLine can be bound non-admitted.
items.livesIn: Surplus lines filings log — compliance drive, 'Eligibility' sheet

items.name: Deal folder naming convention
items.description: UW drive convention (ACCOUNT_STATE_EFFDATE) that is the de facto policy index — the deal folder, not PAS C, holds the full account picture.
items.livesIn: UW shared drive — \\specialty\deals\TEO

components.name: Coverages
components.expression: Tech E&O + MPL wrongful acts with privacy add-on

items.name: Technology professional services wrongful acts
items.description: Insuring Agreement A — liability for negligent acts, errors or omissions in the performance of technology services or failure of technology products to perform.
items.livesIn: Carrier form TEO-1000 (02/26 ed.) — manuscript wording library

items.name: Media liability
items.description: Insuring Agreement B — personal and advertising injury (defamation, IP infringement excluding patent) arising from content in the insured's media.
items.livesIn: Carrier form TEO-1000 (02/26 ed.) — manuscript wording library

items.name: Network security & privacy liability add-on
items.description: Sublimited third-party cover ($1M max) for failure of network security or wrongful disclosure of PII, bolted on by endorsement for accounts without standalone cyber.
items.livesIn: Endorsement TEO-2110 (.docx) — manuscript wording library

items.name: Subpoena assistance expense
items.description: Pays legal costs (typically $25k sublimit) to respond to a subpoena arising from professional services when the insured is not a party to the suit.
items.livesIn: Carrier form TEO-1000 (02/26 ed.) — supplementary payments section

items.name: Disciplinary proceeding expense
items.description: Defense expense sublimit ($50k) for regulatory or licensing-board proceedings alleging a wrongful act in professional services.
items.livesIn: Carrier form TEO-1000 (02/26 ed.) — supplementary payments section

items.name: Contractual liability carve-back
items.description: Exception to the contract exclusion preserving cover for liability the insured would have absent the contract, plus assumed breach-of-warranty in tech services agreements.
items.livesIn: Carrier form TEO-1000 (02/26 ed.) — exclusions section carve-back

items.name: Retroactive date / prior acts
items.description: Coverage applies only to wrongful acts on or after the scheduled retro date; full prior acts granted for clean accounts with continuous cover.
items.livesIn: Declarations item 6, PAS C policy record + claims-made tracking spreadsheet

items.name: Extended reporting period options (1/3/6 yr)
items.description: Optional ERPs of one, three or six years purchasable at cancellation/non-renewal to report claims from pre-termination wrongful acts.
items.livesIn: Endorsement TEO-2400 (.docx) — manuscript wording library

items.name: Loss of documents / data re-creation extension
items.description: First-party expense extension ($100k sublimit) to restore client documents or data damaged or lost while in the insured's care.
items.livesIn: Manuscript extension endorsement — per-account .docx, wording library

items.name: Innocent insured protection
items.description: Severability provision preserving cover for insured persons who neither committed nor had knowledge of fraudulent or dishonest acts of another insured.
items.livesIn: Carrier form TEO-1000 (02/26 ed.) — conditions section

components.name: Terms
components.expression: Claims-made-and-reported with SIR and defense-inside

items.name: Claims-made-and-reported trigger
items.description: Claim must be first made against the insured during the policy period and reported to the carrier within 60 days after expiry.
items.livesIn: Carrier form TEO-1000 (02/26 ed.) — insuring agreement; tracked in claims-made tracking spreadsheet

items.name: Retro date scheduling
items.description: Per-insured retro date on the declarations; advancement at renewal is prohibited without line-leader referral because it strips prior-acts cover.
items.livesIn: Claims-made tracking spreadsheet — retro-date column, UW drive

items.name: Defense inside the limit
items.description: Defense costs erode the limit of liability (cost-inclusive), the standard structure for this product across all hazard classes.
items.livesIn: Carrier form TEO-1000 (02/26 ed.) — limit of liability section

items.name: Self-insured retention (not deductible)
items.description: SIR of $10k–$250k that the insured funds first, including defense within the SIR; carrier consent required on counsel selection above the SIR.
items.livesIn: Declarations item 4; negotiated level recorded in Word pricing memo

items.name: Limit menu $1M–$10M
items.description: Per-claim and aggregate limits offered from $1M/$1M to $10M/$10M; above $5M requires financial condition review.
items.livesIn: TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx — 'ILF' tab; PAS C limit fields

items.name: ERP premium factors
items.description: ERP pricing fixed at 100% / 150% / 200% of expiring annual premium for the 1 / 3 / 6 year options, fully earned at election.
items.livesIn: Endorsement TEO-2400 rate table — manuscript wording library

items.name: Interrelated wrongful acts clause
items.description: All claims arising from the same or logically connected wrongful acts are deemed a single claim first made when the earliest was made.
items.livesIn: Carrier form TEO-1000 (02/26 ed.) — definitions

items.name: 50/50 hammer clause
items.description: If the insured refuses a settlement the carrier recommends, further defense and indemnity above that amount is shared 50/50.
items.livesIn: Carrier form TEO-1000 (02/26 ed.) — consent to settle condition

components.name: Rating
components.expression: Revenue-band base rates × hazard class × claims load

items.name: Revenue-band base rate table
items.description: Base rate per $1,000 of professional services revenue in ten revenue bands, the primary exposure base for both tech E&O and MPL.
items.livesIn: TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx — 'BaseRates' tab, actuarial drive

items.name: Hazard class factor
items.description: Multiplier 0.85–2.10 by tech services taxonomy class; MSPs and telecom carry the highest factors due to systemic downstream exposure.
items.livesIn: TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx — 'HazardClass' tab

items.name: Claims load factor
items.description: Debit of 1.10–1.75 driven by claim frequency and paid severity over the trailing five years from the supplemental claims application.
items.livesIn: TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx — 'ClaimsLoad' tab; source data in deal file loss runs

items.name: Retro date credit/debit
items.description: Credit up to 15% for a retro date matching inception (no prior acts); full prior acts is the base rate.
items.livesIn: TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx — 'RetroFactor' cell block

items.name: SIR credit curve
items.description: Credit curve from the $10k base SIR up to 25% credit at $250k, interpolated in the rater.
items.livesIn: TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx — 'SIRCredit' tab

items.name: Increased limit factors
items.description: ILFs from the $1M base to $10M, capped per hazard class; the rater blocks ILF above class-specific max lines.
items.livesIn: TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx — 'ILF' tab

items.name: Contract risk management credit
items.description: Up to 10% credit for consistent use of a standard MSA with limitation-of-liability and mutual indemnification clauses, verified from sample contracts in the deal file.
items.livesIn: TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx — 'RiskMgmt' inputs; evidence in UW deal file

items.name: State factor page
items.description: State relativities reflecting venue severity (e.g. IL/CA debits) applied to the multi-state exposure split from the application.
items.livesIn: TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx — 'StateFactors' tab

items.name: Rater workbook version control
items.description: The rater itself — TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx — versioned by filename on the actuarial drive; the rater run is pasted into the pricing memo as the technical-price record.
items.livesIn: Actuarial drive — \\actuarial\raters\TEO\TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx

components.name: Pricing
components.expression: Technical price + SL taxes, fees and wholesale commission

items.name: Surplus lines premium tax per state
items.description: Non-admitted premium tax remitted by the broker per home state (e.g. CA 3.00%, TX 4.85%, NY 3.60%), calculated on gross premium.
items.livesIn: Surplus lines filings log — compliance drive, tax-rate sheet

items.name: CA stamping fee 0.18%
items.description: Surplus Line Association of California stamping fee of 0.18% on CA-home-state placements, itemized separately on the invoice.
items.livesIn: Surplus lines filings log — compliance drive; broker invoice in deal file

items.name: Policy fee
items.description: Fully earned policy fee of $250–$500 per policy, charged where the home state permits fees on surplus lines placements.
items.livesIn: PAS C billing record — fee code POLFEE; state permissibility sheet in SL log

items.name: Wholesale broker commission
items.description: 15%–17.5% commission to the wholesale broker, negotiated per relationship and netted from gross premium at settlement.
items.livesIn: PAS C producer record; commission grid PDF on product line SharePoint

items.name: Minimum premium / minimum earned
items.description: Minimum premium $2,500 and 25% minimum earned premium at inception on all ProLine placements.
items.livesIn: Quote letter template + Word pricing memo, deal file

items.name: Technical vs walk-away price memo
items.description: The Word pricing memo records rater technical price, target price, walk-away price and the rationale for any deviation the underwriter binds.
items.livesIn: UW deal file — pricing memo .docx per account

items.name: ERP premium (fully earned)
items.description: ERP election premium (100/150/200% of annual) is fully earned at election and invoiced as a one-time endorsement premium.
items.livesIn: PAS C endorsement premium record; TEO-2400 rate table

components.name: Underwriting Rules
components.expression: Email referral grid + class and controls gates

items.name: Revenue referral threshold
items.description: Accounts with professional services revenue above $50M must be referred by email to the professional lines leader before quoting.
items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF — product line SharePoint; referral emails in deal file

items.name: Prior claims referral
items.description: Any paid claim above $100k, or more than two claims of any size, in the trailing five years triggers line-leader referral.
items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF; loss runs in UW deal file

items.name: Prohibited classes
items.description: Cryptocurrency exchanges, adult content platforms and firms providing gambling software are declines — no referral path.
items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF — prohibited class list

items.name: Medical-adjacent tech referral
items.description: Medical billing, EMR/EHR vendors and telehealth platforms must be referred due to bodily-injury adjacency of a tech failure.
items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF; referral emails in deal file

items.name: Sanctions / OFAC screening at clearance
items.description: Insured and known principals screened against OFAC SDN and consolidated lists at submission clearance, rescreened at bind.
items.livesIn: Clearance checklist in UW deal file; screening tool extract attached

items.name: Retro date advancement prohibition
items.description: Renewal retro dates may never be advanced without line-leader sign-off, since advancement removes prior-acts cover the insured has paid for.
items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF; claims-made tracking spreadsheet audit column

items.name: Financial review above $5M limits
items.description: Limits above $5M require a current financial statement review documented in the pricing memo before release of the quote.
items.livesIn: Word pricing memo — financials section; statements in deal file

items.name: Signed application warranty
items.description: Signed application and warranty statement required within 30 days of bind; bind is subject-to and flagged for cancellation if not received.
items.livesIn: Subjectivities tracker sheet in UW deal file

items.name: Healthcare staffing carve-out
items.description: Staffing firms placing healthcare workers are ineligible under ProLine and are routed to the healthcare MPL product instead.
items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF — class routing table

items.name: TEO-2400 extended reporting period endorsement

items.name: Specific matter exclusion (manuscript)

items.name: State surplus lines notices & service of suit
items.description: State-mandated SL disclosure stamps (e.g. CA D-1, NY excess line notice) and service-of-suit clause attached per home state.

components.name: Filings
components.expression: Non-admitted — SL tax/stamping filings only

items.name: Surplus lines filing per placement
items.description: Broker files each ProLine placement with the home-state SL stamping office/regulator; compliance logs filing number and date.
items.livesIn: Surplus lines filings log — compliance drive, per-policy rows

items.name: CA SL-1 / SL-2 diligent search forms
items.description: California confidential report of placement (SL-1) and diligent search declaration (SL-2) for CA home-state insureds.
items.livesIn: Surplus lines filings log + scanned forms in compliance drive folder

items.name: NY ELANY excess line affidavit
items.description: ELANY affidavit (Part A/C) filed for New York home-state placements with the stamped copy retained.
items.livesIn: Compliance drive — ELANY affidavit folder; log row per policy

items.name: TX SLTX stamping filing
items.description: Texas Surplus Lines Stamping Office filing and stamping-fee remittance for TX home-state placements.
items.livesIn: Surplus lines filings log — TX sheet

items.name: Export list eligibility check
items.description: Pre-bind check whether the class appears on the state export list (no diligent search needed) or requires declinations documentation.
items.livesIn: Surplus lines filings log — eligibility sheet; declinations in deal file

items.name: No admitted rate/form filings
items.description: Product intentionally carries no admitted filings — form and rate freedom is the reason ProLine lives on non-admitted paper; noted in the compliance register.
items.livesIn: Compliance drive — product regulatory register entry

components.name: Lifecycle Behavior
components.expression: Email submission → rater/memo quote → manual PAS C bind

items.name: Submission intake & deal file creation
items.description: Broker email submission is saved to a new deal folder (application, loss runs, financials) which becomes the account's system of record.
items.livesIn: UW shared drive — deal folder per account

items.name: Clearance & sanctions screen
items.description: Account cleared against the in-force and submission log for broker-of-record conflicts, with OFAC screen run at the same step.
items.livesIn: Clearance log spreadsheet — UW drive; screen extract in deal file

items.name: Rater run & pricing memo
items.description: Underwriter completes TEO-Rater-v5.3.xlsx, pastes the output into the Word pricing memo, and records technical/target/bound price.
items.livesIn: UW deal file — rater copy + pricing memo .docx

items.name: Quote letter release
items.description: Quote letter with terms, subjectivities and SL disclosures generated from the template and emailed to the wholesale broker.
items.livesIn: Quote letter template — product line SharePoint; sent copy in deal file

items.name: Bind & manual PAS C entry
items.description: On broker bind order, the underwriting assistant keys the policy into PAS C (DB2) — coverage codes, limits, SIR, retro date, producer and fees.
items.livesIn: PAS C (DB2) policy record; bind order email in deal file

items.name: Policy issuance by document team
items.description: Document team assembles the policy from TEO-1000 plus the endorsement set out of the wording library and issues to the broker within 30 days.
items.livesIn: Manuscript wording library + issued PDF in deal file

items.name: Mid-term endorsements
items.description: Endorsement requests drafted as manuscript .docx, premium computed in the rater or flat-charged, then re-keyed into PAS C as endorsement transactions.
items.livesIn: PAS C endorsement records; .docx in deal file

items.name: Renewal re-underwrite
items.description: Renewal requires an updated application and loss runs; the account is re-rated in the current rater version and re-memoed — no auto-renewal exists.
items.livesIn: Renewal deal folder; claims-made tracking spreadsheet continuity check

items.name: Cancellation & ERP election window
items.description: On cancellation/non-renewal the insured has 60 days to elect an ERP; elections and deadlines are tracked manually in the claims-made spreadsheet.
items.livesIn: Claims-made tracking spreadsheet — ERP columns, UW drive

products.name: Private Company D&O ManagementOne
products.description: Private company directors & officers liability with ABC side structure and optional EPL and fiduciary modules, financially underwritten per account and issued on surplus lines paper.

items.livesIn: PAS C (DB2) — PRODMST + coverage-part flags

items.livesIn: Policy form MGT-1000 (05/25 ed.) — coverage part structure; PAS C flags

items.name: Industry class taxonomy

items.livesIn: DO-Rater-v3.1.xlsx — 'IndustryClass' tab, actuarial drive

components.name: Coverages
components.expression: ABC sides + EPL/fiduciary modules

items.name: Side A — non-indemnifiable loss
items.description: Pays loss of individual directors and officers when the company cannot or does not indemnify (insolvency, legal prohibition); no retention applies.
items.livesIn: Policy form MGT-1000 (05/25 ed.) — Insuring Agreement A

items.name: Side B — corporate reimbursement
items.description: Reimburses the company for indemnification it pays on behalf of insured persons, subject to the B/C retention.
items.livesIn: Policy form MGT-1000 (05/25 ed.) — Insuring Agreement B

items.name: Side C — entity coverage
items.description: Covers the private company entity itself for claims — broad-form entity cover (not securities-only) as is standard for private D&O.
items.livesIn: Policy form MGT-1000 (05/25 ed.) — Insuring Agreement C

items.name: Side A DIC excess companion
items.description: Optional difference-in-conditions excess Side A limit that drops down when the underlying policy wrongfully fails to pay or is rescinded.
items.livesIn: Side A DIC form MGT-1100 (.docx) — manuscript wording library

items.name: EPL module
items.description: Employment practices liability coverage part — wrongful termination, discrimination, harassment, retaliation — including third-party EPL for customer claims.
items.livesIn: EPL coverage part endorsement MGT-2200 — wording library

items.name: Fiduciary module
items.description: Fiduciary liability coverage part for ERISA breach claims against sponsors and plan fiduciaries, with voluntary settlement (DOL/IRS program) sublimit.
items.livesIn: Fiduciary coverage part endorsement MGT-2300 — wording library

items.name: Derivative demand investigation sublimit
items.description: $250k sublimit for the company's costs of investigating a shareholder derivative demand, outside the retention.
items.livesIn: Policy form MGT-1000 (05/25 ed.) — sublimits schedule

items.name: Crisis / public relations expense
items.description: $50k sublimit for crisis communications costs after a covered event naming a director or officer.
items.livesIn: Policy form MGT-1000 (05/25 ed.) — supplementary payments

items.name: Additional Side A limit for independent directors
items.description: Dedicated $1M excess limit available only to outside/independent directors after all other insurance is exhausted.
items.livesIn: Endorsement MGT-2150 — wording library

components.name: Terms
components.expression: ABC tower order, non-rescindable Side A, shared/separate module limits

items.name: Order of payments (priority to Side A)
items.description: Policy directs loss payment first to non-indemnifiable Side A loss of individuals, then B, then C — protecting individuals if the limit is stressed.
items.livesIn: Policy form MGT-1000 (05/25 ed.) — order of payments clause

items.name: Shared vs separate module limits
items.description: EPL and fiduciary modules either share the D&O aggregate or carry separate limits, elected on the declarations and priced accordingly.
items.livesIn: Declarations items 3–5; DO-Rater-v3.1.xlsx module pricing

items.name: Retentions: $0 Side A / tiered B-C
items.description: No retention on Side A; Side B/C retention $25k–$250k by size and class; EPL retention set separately (often higher, e.g. $50k CA accounts).
items.livesIn: Declarations item 6; pricing memo rationale

items.name: Non-rescindable Side A
items.description: Coverage under Insuring Agreement A cannot be rescinded for application misrepresentation — severability protects innocent insureds.
items.livesIn: Policy form MGT-1000 (05/25 ed.) — severability & non-rescindability clause

items.name: Claims-made with 90-day reporting
items.description: Claims-made trigger with 90-day post-expiry reporting window and noticed-circumstance mechanism preserving cover for later related claims.
items.livesIn: Policy form MGT-1000 (05/25 ed.); claims-made tracking spreadsheet

items.name: ERP options 1/3/6 years
items.description: Standard ERP menu at 100/150/200% of annualized premium; a separate 6-year run-off tail applies automatically on change in control.
items.livesIn: Policy form MGT-1000 + ERP endorsement MGT-2400 rate table

items.name: Conduct exclusions — final adjudication
items.description: Fraud and illegal-profit exclusions apply only after final, non-appealable adjudication in the underlying action, preserving defense until then.
items.livesIn: Policy form MGT-1000 (05/25 ed.) — exclusions section

items.name: Defense inside the limit, duty to defend EPL only
items.description: Defense costs erode limits across all parts; the carrier owes a duty to defend on the EPL module but indemnifies defense on D&O/FID.
items.livesIn: Policy form MGT-1000 (05/25 ed.) — defense provisions

components.name: Rating

items.livesIn: DO-Rater-v3.1.xlsx — 'BaseRates' tab, actuarial drive

items.name: Financial-strength score modifier
items.description: Credit-model score (bureau data plus statement ratios: leverage, liquidity, cash burn) mapped to a 0.80–1.60 modifier; distressed scores also trigger referral.
items.livesIn: DO-Rater-v3.1.xlsx — 'FinScore' tab; score source noted in pricing memo

items.name: Industry class factor
items.description: Class relativities 0.85–1.90; healthcare services and real estate development carry the highest private D&O factors.
items.livesIn: DO-Rater-v3.1.xlsx — 'IndustryClass' tab

items.name: Employee count factor (EPL module)
items.description: EPL module premium driven by headcount bands and state mix, with CA headcount separately weighted.
items.livesIn: DO-Rater-v3.1.xlsx — 'EPL' tab

items.name: Plan assets factor (fiduciary module)
items.description: Fiduciary module rated on total plan assets and plan type (DB plans loaded over DC).
items.livesIn: DO-Rater-v3.1.xlsx — 'FID' tab

items.name: Years-in-business / ownership factor
items.description: Credit for >10 years operating history and stable ownership; debit for PE-sponsored roll-ups and recent leveraged recapitalizations.
items.livesIn: DO-Rater-v3.1.xlsx — 'Ownership' inputs

items.name: Prior litigation load
items.description: Debit from prior D&O/EPL claims and pending litigation disclosed on the application, up to 1.75.

items.name: Wholesale broker commission
items.description: 15% standard wholesale commission on ManagementOne, netted at settlement.
items.livesIn: PAS C producer record; commission grid PDF

items.name: Excluded / referral industries

items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF — industry appetite list

items.name: EPL claims history gate

items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF; EEOC charge history in deal file

items.name: Sanctions / OFAC screening

items.livesIn: Clearance checklist in UW deal file

items.name: Major shareholder exclusion rule
items.description: Any shareholder holding >30% must be disclosed; claims brought by them are excluded via the major shareholder exclusion unless bought back at referral.
items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF; endorsement MGT-2510 in wording library

products.name: CyberEdge Pro
products.description: First- and third-party cyber insurance for US and EU insureds, control-underwritten off the application plus an external attack-surface scan feed, with ransomware sublimit and coinsurance structure.

components.name: Product Taxonomy
components.expression: One cyber product, two regulatory papers (US SL / EU)

items.name: PAS C product code CY-EDGE
items.description: Product master code for CyberEdge Pro with a jurisdiction flag splitting US surplus-lines paper from EU-papered risks.
items.livesIn: PAS C (DB2) — PRODMST + jurisdiction flag

items.name: Industry class taxonomy (cyber)
items.description: Sixteen cyber industry classes with distinct susceptibility profiles — healthcare, municipalities and MSPs flagged as elevated classes.
items.livesIn: CYB-Rater-v2.0.xlsx — 'IndustryClass' tab, actuarial drive

items.name: Record-count exposure tiers
items.description: PII/PHI record-count tiers (under 100k to 10M+) used as a second exposure base alongside revenue.
items.livesIn: CYB-Rater-v2.0.xlsx — 'Records' tab

items.name: Scan-feed vendor mapping
items.description: Mapping of the external scan vendor's domain-level findings taxonomy (open ports, exposed services, cert hygiene) to rater modifier inputs.

items.name: Version lineage v1–v2

items.description: EU-domiciled risks issue on EEA fronting paper with CyberEdge wording attached; US risks issue direct on non-admitted paper.

components.name: Coverages
components.expression: Full first-party + liability cyber grants with systemic-risk carve-outs

items.name: Incident response costs
items.description: First-party costs of breach counsel, digital forensics, notification, call center and credit monitoring, accessed through the carrier's panel vendors.
items.livesIn: Policy form CYB-2000 (01/26 ed.) — Insuring Agreement 1; panel list appendix

items.name: Cyber extortion / ransomware
items.description: Ransom payments and negotiator costs, sublimited to 50% of the aggregate with 20% insured coinsurance; payment subject to OFAC check protocol.
items.livesIn: Policy form CYB-2000 (01/26 ed.) — Insuring Agreement 2 + sublimit schedule

items.name: Business interruption
items.description: Loss of net profit and continuing expenses from a network security event, after the waiting period, through the period of restoration.
items.livesIn: Policy form CYB-2000 (01/26 ed.) — Insuring Agreement 3

items.name: Dependent (contingent) business interruption
items.description: BI from outage at a scheduled IT provider or cloud dependency, sublimited to 25% of aggregate with named-provider schedule.
items.livesIn: Policy form CYB-2000 + dependent provider schedule endorsement

items.name: Data restoration
items.description: Costs to restore or re-create data and reconfigure systems damaged by a covered event, including bricking cover for hardware rendered unusable.
items.livesIn: Policy form CYB-2000 (01/26 ed.) — Insuring Agreement 4

items.name: PCI fines & assessments
items.description: Contractual fines, assessments and card reissuance costs under merchant services agreements following a payment card breach, sublimited.
items.livesIn: Policy form CYB-2000 (01/26 ed.) — Insuring Agreement 5

items.name: Network security & privacy liability
items.description: Third-party liability for security failure or wrongful disclosure of PII/PHI, including regulatory defense.
items.livesIn: Policy form CYB-2000 (01/26 ed.) — Insuring Agreement 6

items.name: Regulatory fines & penalties (where insurable)
items.description: Civil fines including GDPR administrative fines covered to the extent insurable by law in the relevant jurisdiction — insurability matrix maintained by legal.
items.livesIn: Policy form CYB-2000 + GDPR insurability endorsement; legal matrix on compliance drive

items.name: Media liability
items.description: Third-party liability for defamation and IP infringement (excluding patent) arising from digital media content.
items.livesIn: Policy form CYB-2000 (01/26 ed.) — Insuring Agreement 7

items.name: Social engineering / funds transfer fraud
items.description: Sublimited cover ($250k) for fraudulently induced transfers, conditional on callback verification warranty.
items.livesIn: Social engineering endorsement CYB-2210 — wording library

items.name: War & systemic event exclusion with carve-backs
items.description: LMA5564-style state-backed cyber-attack exclusion; carve-backs preserve cover for collateral-damage bystander events not directed at the insured's state.
items.livesIn: War/systemic exclusion endorsement CYB-2900 — wording library

components.name: Terms
components.expression: Waiting periods, coinsurance, panel conditions

items.name: BI waiting period 8–12 hours
items.description: Business interruption attaches only after a waiting period of 8, 10 or 12 hours (elected at bind); the waiting period acts as a time retention.
items.livesIn: Declarations item 7; CYB-Rater-v2.0.xlsx waiting-period credit

items.name: Period of restoration 120–180 days
items.description: BI measured until systems are restored plus a 30-day tail, capped at 120 days standard, 180 by endorsement.
items.livesIn: Policy form CYB-2000 (01/26 ed.) — BI definitions

items.name: Ransomware sublimit + 20% coinsurance
items.description: Extortion capped at 50% of aggregate and the insured retains 20% of every extortion loss — the v2 structural response to ransomware severity.
items.livesIn: Sublimit schedule on declarations; pricing memo rationale

items.name: Per-claim retention
items.description: Monetary retention $25k–$500k by revenue band applying to all insuring agreements except where the waiting period applies instead.
items.livesIn: Declarations item 6; PAS C policy record

items.name: Panel vendor condition
items.description: Breach counsel and forensics must be engaged from the carrier panel (or pre-approved) for costs to be covered — the coverage-critical operating rule at incident time.
items.livesIn: Policy form CYB-2000 — conditions; panel list appendix

items.name: Claims-made liability / discovery first-party split
items.description: Liability sections are claims-made with 60-day reporting; first-party sections trigger on discovery of the event during the period.
items.livesIn: Policy form CYB-2000 (01/26 ed.) — trigger provisions; claims-made tracking spreadsheet

items.name: Aggregate limit structure
items.description: Single policy aggregate $1M–$10M over all insuring agreements, with the sublimit schedule carving extortion, dependent BI, PCI and social engineering.
items.livesIn: Declarations items 3 + sublimit schedule

items.name: ERP option on liability sections
items.description: One-year ERP available at 100% of annual premium on the claims-made liability sections at cancellation/non-renewal.
items.livesIn: ERP endorsement CYB-2400 — wording library

components.name: Rating
components.expression: Revenue + records base, control modifiers from app + scan

items.name: Revenue base rate table
items.description: Base rate per revenue band by industry class — the primary exposure input.
items.livesIn: CYB-Rater-v2.0.xlsx — 'BaseRates' tab, actuarial drive

items.name: Record count factor
items.description: Multiplier by PII/PHI record tier, loading data-heavy insureds independent of revenue.
items.livesIn: CYB-Rater-v2.0.xlsx — 'Records' tab

items.name: MFA modifier
items.description: Credit/debit keyed to MFA coverage of email, remote access and privileged accounts from the application — absence is a decline, partial deployment a debit.
items.livesIn: CYB-Rater-v2.0.xlsx — 'Controls' tab, MFA rows

items.name: EDR deployment modifier
items.description: Credit up to 10% for EDR deployed on >90% of endpoints with 24/7 monitoring (in-house or MDR).
items.livesIn: CYB-Rater-v2.0.xlsx — 'Controls' tab, EDR rows

items.name: Backup posture modifier
items.description: Credit for offline/immutable backups tested within 6 months; untested backups score as absent.
items.livesIn: CYB-Rater-v2.0.xlsx — 'Controls' tab, backup rows

items.name: External scan score modifier
items.description: Modifier 0.90–1.40 from the scan feed's attack-surface grade (exposed services, patching cadence, cert hygiene), refreshed at quote and renewal.
items.livesIn: Scan feed portal score → 'ScanMap' tab in CYB-Rater-v2.0.xlsx

items.name: Ransomware supplemental application factors
items.description: Factors from the ransomware supplemental app — RDP exposure, privileged access management, segmentation, backup isolation — feeding the extortion sublimit pricing.
items.livesIn: Ransomware supplemental app in deal file; 'RansomApp' tab in rater

items.name: EU exposure factor
items.description: Loading for GDPR-exposed EU revenue share reflecting regulatory severity, applied off the geographic revenue split.
items.livesIn: CYB-Rater-v2.0.xlsx — 'Geo' tab

components.name: Pricing
components.expression: US SL tax stack + EU IPT per territory

items.name: US surplus lines premium tax

items.livesIn: Surplus lines filings log — compliance drive, tax-rate sheet

items.name: EU insurance premium tax (IPT)
items.description: IPT applied per risk-location country on EU-papered policies (e.g. DE 19%, NL 21%, FR 9% plus parafiscal charges), computed on the fronting carrier's schedule.
items.livesIn: EU tax schedule — compliance drive; fronting carrier bordereau

items.name: Fronting fee on EU paper
items.description: EEA fronting carrier fee (5% of gross premium) loaded into EU risk pricing and disclosed in the pricing memo.
items.livesIn: Word pricing memo — EU paper section; fronting agreement on compliance drive

items.name: Wholesale broker commission
items.description: 15% standard wholesale commission; direct-retail EU deals occasionally at 12.5% per the producer agreement.
items.livesIn: PAS C producer record; commission grid PDF

items.name: Policy fee (US only)
items.description: $350 fully earned policy fee on US placements where state-permitted; no fee on EU paper.
items.livesIn: PAS C billing record — fee code POLFEE

items.name: Minimum premium
items.description: Minimum premium $5,000 reflecting the fixed cost of the scan-plus-underwrite process on every account.
items.livesIn: Quote letter template + pricing memo

items.name: Technical vs bound price memo
items.description: Rater technical price versus bound price with scan-score justification recorded per account in the Word pricing memo.
items.livesIn: UW deal file — pricing memo .docx

components.name: Underwriting Rules
components.expression: Minimum controls are hard gates; scan findings block quotes

items.name: No MFA = decline
items.description: Absence of MFA on email and remote access is an automatic decline with no referral path — the product's hardest gate.
items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF — cyber minimum controls section

items.name: Minimum backup standard
items.description: Offline or immutable backups tested within 6 months are required for extortion cover; failing accounts get extortion excluded or are declined.
items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF; application controls section in deal file

items.name: Critical scan finding quote block
items.description: Open RDP, exposed databases or EOL internet-facing systems in the scan report block quote release until remediation is evidenced and rescanned.
items.livesIn: Scan feed portal report in deal file; subjectivities tracker

items.name: Prior ransomware referral
items.description: Any ransomware event in the trailing 3 years requires cyber line-leader referral with the forensics report attached.
items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF; referral emails in deal file

items.name: Revenue referral threshold
items.description: Accounts above $250M revenue referred to the cyber lead; above $500M co-underwritten with treaty reinsurer consultation per the QS treaty terms.
items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF; QS treaty special acceptance file

items.name: MSP/MSSP aggregation referral
items.description: Managed service providers referred due to downstream aggregation; dependent-BI exposure to the same provider is tracked bookwide.
items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF; aggregation spreadsheet on UW drive

items.name: Sanctions & ransom payment protocol
items.description: OFAC screen at clearance plus the ransom-payment protocol: any extortion payment requires panel counsel OFAC clearance before reimbursement.
items.livesIn: Clearance checklist; claims protocol memo — compliance drive

items.name: EOL systems threshold
items.description: More than 10% of the estate on end-of-life operating systems triggers referral and a mandatory contingent exclusion for the EOL segment.
items.livesIn: Authority grid PDF; scan report + application in deal file
